review_notes: Corrected the determiner of `חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה` → *the half tribe of Manasseh*: the rectum carries an article and the ASV renders it anarthrously, so the phrase's single *the* is that article's fronted realization under rule 29, not a determiner supplied on `חֲצִי`. Rule 29's last sentence reserves `unrepresented` for a phrase the ASV writes no *the* for at all, and rule 15 gives a present article morpheme the written *the* before any supplied one.

The competing reading, which the accepted alignment took, was a supplied *the* joining `חֲצִי` with the article `unrepresented`; it is set aside because the chapter's other chains with an arthrous rectum and one written *the* — `מֶלֶךְ הָעַי` → *the king of Ai*, `בִּקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן` → *the valley of Lebanon*, `אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה` → *the slopes of Pisgah* — are all read the fronted way.
The first of the three `לְ`s takes the single written *unto*; the two repeated occurrences are `unrepresented` under rules 22 and 40.
